column8: RC findings of the recording harness on the frozen 0.1.8 RC (10/08), owner's call: (1) CoreCaptureBinding saves an unpasted unit with pasted=nil (TypedSendFacts.apply: pasted ? true : nil) but TypedNarrativeCarry.certified needs pasted==false, so in real capture no carry forms: a draft continued after a long pause has its next part withheld as [withheld] and loses its sig :( ending (bug 8 end to end; the summaries-pass carry itself, re-saved with pasted=false, passes); (2) WebTypedRow.valid needs text for chrome-search-url-v1 but the row is sealed with empty text, so each Google search's typed row reads back <unreadable> (the page rows keep the words: bug 7 passes).
